verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public exceptions-reporting API: clients POST a JSON payload to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices, and its docs point users to this API as a way to report errors. Companion ingestion endpoints for deployments and source maps are also documented, so a custom client can send error data without an official SDK. Missing for 10: payload schema and authentication details in the evidence, a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI paths all 404), evidence of third-party compatible SDKs, and a documented ingestion endpoint for non-error Insights events.
